capabilities: underline spelling and grammar errors as you type with click-to-apply fixes
run grammar checks through cloud or local language models
check paragraphs in different languages while skipping LaTeX formulas
maintain custom dictionaries as ordinary notes per language
suggest a better wording for a paragraph on command
extras: Grammar checking requires a language model: a cloud API (paid per use) or a local server needing roughly 8-12 GB of GPU memory. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. LM Studio support is untested and flagged experimental; macOS and iOS spelling are not yet tested.
intentEvidence: On our test sentences models found far more errors than LanguageTool
problem: Obsidian's built-in spellcheck and dictionary-based checkers look at single words, missing sentence-level grammar errors and breaking on inline math or multilingual notes.
